tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience - Minimum 3 years experience in deployment of Manpower for 24 x 7 helpline services are eligible to Participate. Meeting the minimum requirement 20 marks, For every 1 year over and above 3 years 2.5 Marks, max up to 10 Marks

Past Performance - Should have experience of providing Call Takers for 24 x 7 emergency/helpline services in a single order, in for a period of at least one year out of the preceding 5 years from 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 as below - Not less than 150 members (including supervisory staff) to State Government Department/Board/Corporation in Karnataka State OR not less than 300 members (including supervisory staff) to any Private Sector Organisation in Karnataka State Meeting the minimum requirement 20 marks. in case of execution at government organization-For every increase of 10 Call Takers or part thereof over and above 150 members 1 Mark, max up to 10 Marks, - in case of execution at privation organization- For every increase of 20 Call Takers or part thereof over and above 300 members 1 Mark, max up to 10 Marks

Financial - Minimum Annual turnover of Rs.10 Crores during any three years out of preceding 5 years from 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 - Minimum Aggregate of Rs. 30 Crores from the highest 3 years turnover value out of 5 years, specifically from Call Centre Manpower Services/Operations. Meeting the minimum aggregate requirement 20 marks, For increase of every 1 Crore or part thereof in the aggregate turnover (specifically from Call Centre Manpower Services/Operations)of all the three years 1 Mark, up to 10 Marks

Detailed description of the methodology and work plan for performing the Assignment. (Bidders may be asked to make a presentation on the above on any day, after opening of the Technical bid at office of the Commissioner of Police, Bengaluru City, Bengaluru.) As evaluated by the committee: Minimum 0, Maximum 10 Marks. 2 Marks for each of the following points covered. 1. Understanding of DIAL 112. 2. Team Strength and Deliverables of proposed Manpower Development. 3. Roll out plan and Timeline. 4. Training and Quality control. 5. Adherence to Service-Level Agreement (SLA), Monitoring and compliance
